Hymn 336: School Thy Feelings
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: George Careless
Lyricist/Text Author: Charles W. Penrose
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 336 titled "School Thy Feelings" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George Careless and the lyrics were written by Charles W. Penrose.
